title: Chemicalist Industry Platform
description: Complete Lab and Studio catalog for a multi-tenant chemical-industry platform. Business records are owned by their Lab; cross-Lab links are references, never direct database relations. Fully aligned with chemicalist.studio-template version 3.

labs.name: Planning
labs.ownership: Demand forecasts, supply and production plans, planned capacity, and approved S&OP cycles.

studios.name: Demand Planning
studios.description: Demand forecasts, planning periods, scenarios, and approved assumptions.

studios.name: Supply Planning
studios.description: Supply plans and procurement requirements; purchase execution remains owned by Supply Chain.

studios.name: Production Planning
studios.description: Planned production schedules; actual orders and execution remain owned by Production.

studios.name: Capacity Planning
studios.description: Planned capacity scenarios and operating constraints.

studios.name: S&OP
studios.description: Cross-functional sales and operations planning cycles and approvals.

labs.name: Supply Chain
labs.ownership: Suppliers, supplier assessment, sourcing, procurement, purchasing contracts, and commercial import/export.

studios.name: Supplier Management
studios.description: Supplier profiles and business qualification records.

studios.name: Procurement
studios.description: Purchase requests and purchase orders; receipt and stock remain owned by Inventory.

studios.name: Sourcing
studios.description: Sourcing exercises, supplier comparisons, and source decisions.

studios.name: Contracts
studios.description: Supplier contracts and commercial terms.

studios.name: Import & Export
studios.description: Commercial import/export declarations and supporting references.

labs.name: Inventory
labs.ownership: Physical stock, storage locations, reservations, material movements, counts, and inventory status.

studios.name: Warehouse Management
studios.description: Warehouse and controlled storage-area master data.

studios.name: Stock Management
studios.description: Stock position and availability records; finance owns monetary valuation.

studios.name: Material Tracking
studios.description: Material identity, lot/batch traceability, and custody references.

studios.name: Storage Management
studios.description: Storage locations, capacity metadata, and handling conditions.

studios.name: Material Movement
studios.description: Goods receipts and immutable movement records for physical inventory.

studios.name: Stocktaking
studios.description: Stock-count plans, observations, and reconciliation references.

labs.name: Production
labs.ownership: Production orders, batch execution, material consumption, produced quantity, waste, downtime, and performance.

studios.name: Production Orders
studios.description: Released production orders based on approved product and process versions.

studios.name: Batch Management
studios.description: Batch identity, product/process version snapshots, and batch lifecycle.

studios.name: Production Execution
studios.description: Actual execution records and production operations.

studios.name: Material Consumption
studios.description: Actual consumed material records; Inventory remains the source of stock movements.

studios.name: Production Performance
studios.description: Production output, yield, waste, deviations, and downtime measures.

labs.name: Process & Engineering
labs.ownership: Process definitions and parameters, engineering equipment specifications, technical changes, and scale-up assessments.

studios.name: Process Design
studios.description: Process definitions and controlled process revisions.

studios.name: Process Modeling
studios.description: Process models and versioned process parameters.

studios.name: Process Optimization
studios.description: Optimization studies and documented process assumptions.

studios.name: Equipment Engineering
studios.description: Engineering specifications for process equipment; asset operations remain owned by Maintenance & Assets.

studios.name: Process Change
studios.description: Engineering change proposals, approvals, and effective revisions.

studios.name: Scale-up
studios.description: Scale-up assessments from laboratory to industrial process.

labs.name: R&D
labs.ownership: Research projects, experimental formulations, experiment plans, research results, and development candidates.

studios.name: Research Projects
studios.description: Research project scope, objectives, hypotheses, and findings.

studios.name: Formulation
studios.description: Research formulations and versioned experimental composition.

studios.name: Experiment Design
studios.description: Experiment plans and research assumptions.

studios.name: Product Innovation
studios.description: Development candidates proposed to Product; this does not create an active commercial product.

studios.name: Stability Studies
studios.description: Stability study protocols, observations, and results.

studios.name: Computational Chemistry
studios.description: Computational chemistry runs and research result summaries; optional product capability.

labs.name: Product
labs.ownership: Commercial product identity, released product versions, official specifications, and product lifecycle.

studios.name: Product Catalog
studios.description: Commercial product catalog and product identity.

studios.name: Product Specifications
studios.description: Official product specifications and grades.

studios.name: Product Lifecycle
studios.description: Commercial lifecycle decisions for a product.

studios.name: Product Change
studios.description: Versioned changes to commercial product identity and specifications.

studios.name: Product Portfolio
studios.description: Product portfolio groupings and planning references.

labs.name: Quality
labs.ownership: Quality controls and criteria, nonconformance, CAPA, audit findings, release/rejection decisions, and recalls.

studios.name: Quality Control
studios.description: Quality inspections and documented quality decisions.

studios.name: Quality Assurance
studios.description: Quality assurance records, approvals, and evidence references.

studios.name: Quality Specifications
studios.description: Quality acceptance specifications; official product identity remains owned by Product.

studios.name: Nonconformance & CAPA
studios.description: Nonconformance records, corrective actions, and effectiveness evidence.

studios.name: Quality Audit
studios.description: Quality audit plans, findings, and closure evidence.

studios.name: Complaints & Recalls
studios.description: Quality complaints, recall initiation, and product impact references.

labs.name: Laboratory
labs.ownership: Samples, test execution, laboratory methods, measurement results, equipment, facilities, reagents, and consumables.

studios.name: Sample Management
studios.description: Sample identity, chain-of-custody references, and sample lifecycle.

studios.name: Test Execution
studios.description: Test execution and immutable measurement result records.

studios.name: Test Methods
studios.description: Controlled laboratory test methods and revisions.

studios.name: Lab Equipment
studios.description: Laboratory equipment, calibration, and operational status.

studios.name: Lab Facilities
studios.description: Laboratory spaces, rooms, and facility references.

studios.name: Reagents & Consumables
studios.description: Reagent and consumable inventory references; physical stock remains owned by Inventory.

labs.name: EHS

studios.name: Chemical Safety
studios.description: Chemical hazard, safe-handling, and safety document references.

studios.name: Risk Assessment
studios.description: Hazard identification, likelihood, severity, and risk controls.

studios.name: Incident Management
studios.description: Safety incidents, investigations, and corrective actions.

studios.name: Industrial Hygiene
studios.description: Occupational exposure observations and hygiene assessments.

studios.name: Environmental Management
studios.description: Environmental monitoring and limit observations.

studios.name: Waste Management
studios.description: Waste classification, handling, and hazardous-waste declarations.

studios.name: Emergency Preparedness
studios.description: Emergency plans, readiness reviews, and response references.

labs.name: Maintenance & Assets
labs.ownership: Physical assets, maintenance plans, work orders, breakdowns, spare-parts requirements, facilities, utilities, and energy records.

studios.name: Asset Registry
studios.description: Physical asset registry and lifecycle references.

studios.name: Preventive Maintenance
studios.description: Preventive maintenance plans and due dates.

studios.name: Work Orders
studios.description: Maintenance work requests, priorities, and execution windows.

studios.name: Breakdown Management
studios.description: Asset failures, breakdown investigations, and restoration records.

studios.name: Spare Parts
studios.description: Spare-part requirements and references; Inventory owns physical quantities.

studios.name: Facilities & Utilities
studios.description: Facility utility assets and service records.

studios.name: Energy Management
studios.description: Energy usage and performance records.

labs.name: Logistics
labs.ownership: Transport plans, carriers, shipments, tracking, delivery, freight costs, and dangerous-goods transport operations.

studios.name: Transport Planning
studios.description: Transport plans, routes, and schedule windows.

studios.name: Fleet & Carrier
studios.description: Carrier and fleet reference data.

studios.name: Shipment Management
studios.description: Shipment planning and dispatch; sales orders remain owned by Sales.

studios.name: Dangerous Goods
studios.description: Dangerous-goods declarations and transport handling references.

studios.name: Shipment Tracking
studios.description: Shipment status events and proof-of-delivery references.

studios.name: Freight Cost
studios.description: Freight cost records; formal financial posting remains owned by Finance.

labs.name: Sales & Distribution
labs.ownership: Commercial customers, quotations, sales orders, sales pricing, distribution network, and customer service.

studios.description: Commercial customer identity and account references.

studios.name: Sales & Quotations
studios.description: Customer quotations, commercial terms, and validity windows.

studios.name: Sales Orders
studios.description: Confirmed customer orders; inventory reservation, shipment, and invoicing remain owned by their Labs.

studios.name: Pricing
studios.description: Versioned sales price lists and commercial pricing records.

studios.name: Distribution Network
studios.description: Distribution channels and commercial network references.

studios.name: Customer Service
studios.description: Customer service cases, response tracking, and resolution notes.

labs.name: Finance
labs.ownership: Accounting ledger, receivables, payables, formal financial documents, cost, budget, cash flow, and profitability.

studios.name: Accounts Payable & Receivable

studios.name: Cost Management
studios.description: Posted cost entries and cost attribution references.

studios.name: Budget Management

studios.name: Cash Flow

studios.name: Profitability Analysis
studios.description: Profitability analyses for products, customers, and orders.

labs.name: Human Resources

studios.name: Workforce Planning
studios.description: Planned staffing capacity by period and scenario.

studios.name: Performance Management
studios.description: Workforce performance review records and evaluation periods.
